blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tokenizers are commonly optimized for compression, but a compact vocabulary does not necessarily distribute its capacity evenly across languages. We introduce the Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT), a language-agnostic approach that separates structural discovery from vocabulary construction. LCT uses Minimum Description Length, entropy-based boundary signals, and morphotactic constraints to identify reusable linguistic units before constructing a shared vocabulary. Across 104 languages with a 200K-token vocabulary, LCT achieves lower fertility and higher MorphScore than BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, while maintaining comparable cross-lingual disparity in tokenization cost. Across four multilingual downstream benchmarks, LCT improves aggregate score by 1.48, 1.83, and 2.00 points over BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, respectively. Our findings show that compression alone does not predict representation quality and highlight the importance of morphology-driven structural discovery and how frequency is used to allocate the final vocabulary across languages.

LCT在构建一个共享词汇之前,使用最小描述长度,基于 en的边界信号,以及形态约束来识别可重复使用的语言单元. 在104种语言中,有200K-token词汇,LCT实现了比BPE,Unigram,以及平等意识的BPE更低的生育力和更高的morphScore,同时在象征性化成本方面保持了可比的跨语言差异. 在四个多语种下游基准中,LCT的总分分别比BPE,Unigram和对等的BPE提高1.48分,1.83分和2.00分. 我们的研究结果表明,光是压缩并不能预测表达质量,并突出了形态学驱动的结构发现的重要性,以及如何利用频率在语言之间分配最终词汇.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Tokenization determines the units through which language models represent text, with direct consequences for sequence length, vocabulary capacity, and the information available to the model. Subword methods such as Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) and Unigram tokenization make open vocabulary modeling practical by learning reusable units from corpus statistics ( Sennrich et al., 2016 ; Kudo, 2018 ) . In multilingual settings, however, a shared vocabulary must serve languages that differ substantially in corpus size, script, and morphological structure. Frequency driven vocabulary learning can therefore favor patterns from high resource languages and lead to uneven tokenization efficiency across languages ( Rust et al., 2021 ; Foroutan et al., 2026 ) . At the same time, work on morphology aware tokenization shows that the units that best preserve linguistic structure need not be the same units that optimize compression ( Vemula et al., 2025 ; Asgari et al., 2026 ) . Conventional subword tokenizers typically use the same vocabulary learning process both to identify reusable units and to determine the final tokens exposed to the model.
blocks.zh: tokenization决定了语言模型代表文本的单位,直接影响了序列长度,词汇容量,以及模型可用的信息. Byte Pair Encoding(BPE)和Unigram sidentization等子词方法通过从实体统计中学习可重复使用的单位,使开放式词汇模型实用(Sennrich等,2016;Kudo,2018). 然而,在多语种环境中,共同的词汇必须服务于在体积、脚本和形态结构上差异很大的语言。 因此,频率驱动的词汇学习可以有利于高资源语言的模式,并导致不同语言之间的符号化效率不平衡(Rust等,2021;Foroutan等,2026)。 同时,关于形态感知符号化的研究表明,最能保存语言结构的单位不需要是优化压缩的同一种单位(Vemula等,2025;Asgari等,2026.). 常规子词的活化符号通常使用相同的词汇学习过程,既能识别可再用单位,又能确定被模型所曝光的最终符号.

blocks.en: We introduce the Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT), which separates latent structural discovery from surface vocabulary construction. LCT first learns reusable internal structure from multilingual text using minimum description length segmentation, branching entropy, and morphotactic refinement under language-balanced evidence. These latent pieces guide vocabulary learning but need not correspond to the final tokens consumed by the model. LCT then constructs a fixed surface vocabulary by selectively recombining latent pieces according to their utility for efficient representation. This allows structural information to guide vocabulary construction without constraining the final surface segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Lententt Core Tokenizer(LCT),它将潜在的结构发现与地表词汇构造区分开来. LCT首先从多语种文本中学习了可再用的内部结构,使用最小描述长度分解,分支化的 en,以及语言平衡证据下的形态修饰. 这些潜在的棋子指导了词汇的学习,但不需要与模型所消耗的最终符号对应. 然后LCT通过有选择地根据潜在棋子的效用重新组合来构建固定的表面词汇来进行高效的表达. 这使得结构信息可以指导词汇构造而不会限制最终的地表分化.

blocks.en: We evaluate LCT across 104 languages against BPE, Unigram, and Parity-Aware BPE under matched corpus, vocabulary budget, and encoder architecture. LCT achieves lower fertility and higher MorphScore than all three baselines while maintaining cross-lingual disparity in tokenization cost comparable to BPE. Under controlled encoder pretraining, LCT improves the aggregate downstream score by 1.48, 1.83, and 2.00 points over BPE, Unigram, and Parity-Aware BPE, respectively.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: (i) we introduce LCT, a tokenizer design that decouples latent structural discovery from surface vocabulary construction; (ii) we show across 104 languages that this design jointly improves tokenization efficiency and morphological alignment while maintaining comparable cross-lingual tokenization-cost disparity; and (iii) we show through controlled multilingual encoder pretraining that these improvements extend to downstream representations.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面:(一) 我们采用LCT,一种将潜在的结构发现从表层词汇构造中脱钩的示意器设计;(二) 我们在104种语言中显示,这种设计共同提高了示意性效率和形态一致性,同时保持了相可比较的跨语言示意-成本差异;(三) 我们通过可控多语种编码器预训,表明这些改进延伸到下游表述。

blocks.en: 2 Latent Core Tokenizer
blocks.zh: 2个核心切除器

blocks.en: The central idea of LCT is that the units used to understand a word during tokenizer training need not be the units emitted to a neural model. Conventional frequency-based tokenizers usually discover reusable pieces and compress text in the same operation. LCT separates these goals: it first learns a latent structural analysis, then uses that analysis to construct a fixed surface vocabulary. The latent pieces guide vocabulary learning but are not labels or additional inputs presented to the encoder.
blocks.zh: LCT的中心思想是,在活化器训练中用来理解一个单词的单位不需要是向神经模型排放的单位. 基于常规频率的活化剂通常在同一操作中会发现可重复使用的棋子并压缩文本. LCT将这些目标分开:它首先学习潜在的结构分析,再用这种分析来构建固定的地表词汇. 潜入的棋子引导词汇学习,但不是标签或提交编码器的额外输入.

blocks.en: Given language-indexed corpora { 𝒟 ℓ } \{\mathcal{D}_{\ell}\} and vocabulary budget K K , training has four steps:
blocks.zh: 鉴于语言索引corpora { Dl} { mathcal { D}_{\ell } 和词汇预算 K K ,培训有四个步骤:

blocks.en: 1. Balance the evidence. Word frequencies are rescaled so that each language contributes approximately equal total mass. This is not an equal vocabulary quota: a piece reused across languages can still receive more support. 2. Discover reusable structure. A minimum-description-length segmenter trades the cost of storing pieces against the savings from reusing them. Branching entropy proposes likely internal boundaries, and a morphotactic model distinguishes prefix-, core-, and suffix-like behavior. These signals refine an internal analysis without requiring gold morphological annotations. 3. Construct surface tokens. Supported characters and latent pieces seed the vocabulary. A ranked packer repeatedly merges the adjacent pair that saves the most weighted token occurrences, allowing frequent combinations and complete words to become single tokens. Packing continues until the exact learned-vocabulary budget is filled. 4. Guarantee usable encoding. The learned surface vocabulary is assigned fixed token IDs. At runtime, minimum-token dynamic programming selects among known surface pieces, while UTF-8 byte tokens provide exact reversible coverage for any unseen string.

LCT-MDL nevertheless remains useful because it yields the shortest sequences, omits branching-entropy search and morphotactic induction, and still outperforms BPE. LCT-MEM , in contrast, provides the strongest downstream performance at the cost of a more complex tokenizer-construction pipeline.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 A controllable tokenizer design space
blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 一个可控的可指示器设计空间

blocks.en: Standard BPE and Unigram couple corpus frequency, unit discovery, and surface vocabulary construction inside one objective. LCT exposes two of these choices as independent controls. The temperature τ \tau determines how strongly corpus size influences multilingual evidence, while the discovery objective determines how much structural information is preserved before surface packing. This makes vocabulary allocation a tunable design decision rather than an incidental consequence of the corpus distribution.
blocks.zh: 标准BPE和Unigram 偶联频率,单位发现,以及一个目标内的地表词汇构造. LCT将其中两个选择暴露为独立的控制. 温度\ tau决定了实体大小对多语种证据的影响程度,而发现目标则决定了在表面包装之前保存多少结构信息。 这使得词汇分配成为了可捕性设计决定,而不是实体分配的偶然后果。

blocks.en: The downstream ordering shows why this control matters. Complete equalization at τ = 0 \tau=0 is not consistently better than BPE, whereas partial balancing at τ = 0.2 \tau=0.2 improves both LCT-MDL and LCT-MEM . The useful operating point therefore lies between unrestricted raw frequency and equal language totals. With only two pretrained temperatures, we identify a direction rather than an optimum, but the results show that allocation strength can be selected empirically for the target setting.
blocks.zh: 下游的订单显示了为什么这种控制很重要. 完全均分时为 \\ tau=0 并非一贯优于 BPE,而部分平分时为 \ tau= 0.2 则改善 LCT-MDL 和 LCT-MEM 。 因此,有用的操作点是在无限制的原始频率和等同的语言总数之间。 由于只有两个预先受限的温度,我们确定一个方向,而不是一个最佳的,但结果显示,可以实证地选择分配强度来设定目标。

blocks.en: 5.2 Different objectives support different deployment priorities
blocks.zh: 5.2 不同目标支持不同的部署优先事项

blocks.en: The component choice provides a second operating axis. LCT-MEM gives the strongest morphological alignment and downstream performance, while LCT-MDL produces shorter sequences and omits branching-entropy search and morphotactic induction. Figure 1 shows that LCT-MEM maintains higher MorphScore than the baselines across low-, mid-, and high-resource groups, while vocabulary utilization is also consistently higher or comparable. Fertility is more resource dependent, with clearer LCT gains for low-resource languages and smaller differences relative to BPE in the mid- and high-resource groups. The intrinsic advantage of LCT is therefore not explained by compression alone.
blocks.zh: 组件选择提供了第二个操作轴. LCT-MEM给出了最强的形态对接和下游性能,而LCT-MDL则产生更短的序列并省去分支-通体搜索和形态诱导. 图1显示,LCT-MEM在低、中和高资源组别中保持高于基线的莫夫分数,而词汇利用率也始终较高或可比。 生育率更依赖于资源,在低资源语言方面LCT收益更明显,在中高资源群体中与BPE相比差异较小. 因此,LCT的内在优势并非仅由压缩来解释.

blocks.en: This should not be confused with a demonstrated tokenizer-runtime speedup. Shorter sequences reduce encoder computation, and LCT-MDL removes training-time components, but the current LCT Hugging Face adapter is implemented as a Python slow tokenizer. Compiling the lossless packing algorithm into an optimized runtime remains necessary before making serving-latency claims.
blocks.zh: 这不应与显示的象征性运行时间速度相混淆。 更短的序列会减少编码器的计算,而LCT-MDL会去除训练时组件,但目前的LCT Hugging Face适配器作为Python慢活化活化器被执行. 将无损失包装算法汇编成最优化的运行时间,在提出适龄索赔之前仍有必要。

blocks.en: 5.3 Allocation parity is not outcome parity
blocks.zh: 5.3 分配平价不是结果平价

blocks.en: The downstream gains are also resource dependent. Figure 5 shows relatively small differences among tokenizers for low-resource languages, with clearer separation in the mid- and high-resource groups, where LCT-MEM at τ = 0.2 \tau=0.2 performs strongest. This suggests that better structural units and vocabulary allocation are most useful when the encoder has sufficient pretraining data to learn from them.
blocks.zh: 下游的收益也取决于资源。 图5显示低资源语言的标语差异相对较小,在中高资源组中,LCT-MEM的分出更为明确,其中LCT-MEM = 0.2\tau= 0.2的分出效果最强. 这表明,当编码器有足够的预训数据从中学习时,更好的结构单位和词汇分配最为有用.

blocks.en: The result also exposes an important limitation. LCT can redistribute vocabulary capacity and reduce cross-language fragmentation, but better allocation does not by itself guarantee stronger outcomes for languages with the least pretraining data. Languages with very little training text may receive better pieces without providing enough evidence for the encoder to exploit them. Future work should therefore optimize low-resource outcomes directly rather than treating lower allocation or Cost Gini as sufficient, including resource-aware temperature schedules, language- or script-conditioned allocation floors, downstream-sensitive structural objectives, and evaluation with larger low-resource task suites and independent pretraining seeds.
blocks.zh: 结果也暴露出一个重要的局限性。 LCT可以重新分配词汇容量并减少跨语言分化,但更好的分配本身并不能保证预训数据最少的语言获得更强的结果. 培训文本很少的语言可能会得到更好的文本,而不会为编码器利用这些文本提供足够的证据。 因此,今后的工作应直接优化低资源成果,而不是将低资源分配或Cost Gini视为足够,包括具有资源意识的温度表、语言或文字条件的分配底线、对下游敏感的结构目标,以及使用更大的低资源任务包和独立预训种子的评价。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Multilingual tokenization must distribute finite vocabulary capacity across languages with highly unequal data availability. Prior work has studied language specific vocabulary allocation, cross language vocabulary overlap, and disparities in tokenization efficiency ( Rust et al., 2021 ; Zheng et al., 2021 ; Limisiewicz et al., 2023 ; Lundin et al., 2026 ) . Parity Aware BPE directly modifies BPE merge selection to reduce cross language compression disparities ( Foroutan et al., 2026 ) . LCT similarly reduces the influence of corpus size on multilingual vocabulary learning, but separates language balancing and latent structural discovery from subsequent surface vocabulary construction.
blocks.zh: 多语种符号化必须在各个语言之间分配有限的词汇能力,数据提供情况极不平等。 先前的工作研究了特定语言词汇分配,跨语言词汇重叠,以及象征性化效率的差异(Rust等,2021;Zheng等,2021;Limisiewicz等,2023;Lundin等,2026). 均等 意识到BPE直接修改了BPE合并选择以减少跨语言压缩差距(Foroutan等,2026). LCT同样也减少了实体大小对多语种词汇学习的影响,但将语言平衡和潜在结构发现与随后的地表词汇构造区分开来.

blocks.en: A complementary line of work incorporates morphological structure into tokenization. Unsupervised morphological segmentation has long used minimum description length to identify reusable subword structure ( Creutz and Lagus, 2007 ) , while recent approaches incorporate morphological information through boundary constraints, segmented training data, or transformations that expose internal structure ( Asgari et al., 2026 ; García et al., 2025 ; Vemula et al., 2025 ; Gazit et al., 2025 ) . MorphBPE is particularly close to LCT in using morphology during vocabulary learning, but its morphological boundaries constrain the final BPE segmentation. LCT instead uses structural analysis as an intermediate latent representation and allows latent pieces to be recombined when constructing the final surface vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 一项补充性的工作将形态结构纳入象征性工作。 未经监督的形态分化长期以来一直使用最小描述长度来识别可再使用的子词结构(Creutz and Lagus, 2007.),而最近的方法通过边界限制,分化训练数据,或暴露内部结构的变相,纳入了形态信息(Asgari等,2026;García等,2025;Vemula等,2025;Gazit等,2025.). MorphBPE在词汇学习中特别接近于LCT使用形态学,但其形态边界制约了最终的BPE分化. 相反,LCT使用结构分析作为中间潜在代表,在构建最终表面词汇时允许将潜在块重新组合.

blocks.en: Recent work also shows that compression, morphological alignment, and downstream performance need not favor the same tokenizer ( Vemula et al., 2025 ; Asgari et al., 2026 ) . LCT builds on this distinction by separating structural discovery from surface vocabulary construction and evaluating both tokenizer quality and learned multilingual representations.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作还表明,压缩、形态相接和下游性能不需要偏好同样的标致剂(Vemula等,2025;Asgari等,2026)。 LCT以这种区别为基础,将结构发现与地表词汇构造区分开来,并评价标语质量和所学多语种表现.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce the Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT), which separates latent structural discovery from surface vocabulary construction. Across 104 languages, LCT improves intrinsic tokenizer quality over BPE, Unigram, and Parity-Aware BPE, while controlled encoder pretraining shows that LCT-MEM at τ = 0.2 \tau=0.2 improves aggregate downstream performance by 1.48, 1.83, and 2.00 points over the three baselines, respectively. Our ablations further show that the configuration producing the shortest sequences is not the one producing the strongest downstream representations, indicating that compression alone is not sufficient for tokenizer selection. The gains also vary by resource level, with smaller downstream improvements for languages with the least pretraining data, showing that better tokenization can improve multilingual representation and vocabulary allocation without removing the separate constraint imposed by limited data.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Lententt Core Tokenizer(LCT),它将潜在的结构发现与地表词汇构造区分开来. 在104种语言中,LCT比BPE,Unigram,和Pality-Aware BPE改进了内在的活化剂质量,而受控的编码器预训显示,LCT-MEM = 0.2\tau= 0.2的LCT-MEM 分别比三个基线提高1.48分,1.83分和2.00分的总下游性能. 我们的平面图进一步显示,产生最短序列的配置并不是产生最强下游表示的配置,表明光是压缩不足以选择标致剂. 收益也因资源水平而异,对语言的下游改进较小,预培训数据最少,这表明更好的标识可以改善多语种代表性和词汇分配,而不会消除有限数据造成的单独制约。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our results provide evidence that separating structural discovery from surface vocabulary construction can improve multilingual tokenization and downstream representations, but several aspects of the current evaluation limit the scope of these conclusions.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果提供了证据,表明将结构发现与地表词汇构造区分开来,可以改善多语种象征化和下游表述,但目前评价的几个方面限制了这些结论的范围.

blocks.en: Single pretraining seed : all seven encoders were pretrained once, so the reported variance reflects fine-tuning variation only. We therefore cannot exclude the possibility that part of the 1.48 1.48 -point improvement over BPE reflects pretraining variance. Replicating encoder pretraining across multiple seeds would provide a stronger estimate of the tokenizer effect.
blocks.zh: 单一预训种子:所有7个编码器都预训过一次,因此所报差异只反映微调变化. 因此,我们不能排除以下可能性:1.48 1.48点比最低教育标准改进部分反映了培训前的差异。 复制多粒种子的编码器预试能更有力地估计出活化剂的效果。

blocks.en: Scale : our experiments use DeBERTa-v3 XSmall encoders. The observed effects therefore establish the value of LCT at this model scale, but may not transfer unchanged to larger models, which may be better able to recover from suboptimal segmentation.
blocks.zh: 缩放:我们的实验使用DeBERTa-v3 X Small编码器. 因此所观测到的效果在这个模型尺度上确定了LCT的值,但可能不会不变地转移到更大的模型上,这样可能更能从次优化分解中恢复.

blocks.en: Task coverage : 62 of the 79 evaluated languages are represented only in Belebele, making the aggregate result heavily influenced by this benchmark. XNLI, XStoryCloze, and PAWS-X cover substantially fewer languages, and XStoryCloze has only 360 training examples. Broader multilingual evaluation is therefore needed to determine how consistently the observed gains extend across task types.
blocks.zh: 任务范围:在79种受评价的语言中,62种只使用Belebele语,使总结果受到这一基准的严重影响。 XNLI,XStoryCloze,和PAWS-X覆盖的语言要少得多,而XStoryCloze只有360个培训实例. 因此,需要更广泛的多语种评价,以确定所观察到的成果在各类任务之间如何一致地延伸。

blocks.en: Search : although 48 LCT configurations are evaluated intrinsically, only two values of τ \tau and two structural objectives are taken forward to encoder pretraining. The downstream experiments therefore identify useful directions rather than an optimal configuration, and conclusions about the relationship between intrinsic and downstream behavior are based on a much smaller subset of the full design space.
blocks.zh: 搜索 : 尽管48 LCT配置被内在评价,只有\\tau的两个值和两个结构目标被推向编码器预训. 因此下游实验确定了有用的方向而不是最佳的配置,关于内在行为与下游行为之间关系的结论是基于整个设计空间中一个更小的子集.

blocks.en: Single downstream architecture : all downstream experiments use the same DeBERTa-v3 XSmall architecture. This controls architecture as a source of variation, but does not establish that the observed tokenizer effects generalize to other encoder architectures or to decoder-only language models.
blocks.zh: 单下游建筑:所有下游实验都使用同名的DeBERTa-v3 XSmall建筑. 这控制了架构作为变异源,但并没有确定所观测到的活化器效果一般化到其他编码器架构或者去解码器唯一的语言模型.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work does not involve human participants or the collection of new personal data. The experiments use existing multilingual corpora and public evaluation benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 这项工作不涉及人类参与者或收集新的个人数据。 这些实验使用现有的多语种公司和公共评价基准。
